main.description: Persist a browser-side inference result. ADR-2605111200 path: CF Worker edge proxy → bpmn-dispatcher → LangServer pod → INSERT vertex_ameno_inferenceresult. PII-free public AT Record (federable). Field-level encryption (signal:v1:{ciphertext}) MAY be applied to the output text by the client when private mode is selected.

modelId.description: Engine model id used (e.g. gemma-4-e2b-it, gemma-4-e4b-it)

actorDid.description: Per-actor LoRA scoping DID, or omit for anonymous

loraAdapters.description: LoRA adapter ids merged into base model

output.description: Plain text or signal:v1:{ciphertext} for private mode

webgpuAdapter.description: GPU adapter name reported by navigator.gpu
